content:
maria: @here Planned maintenance for control-plane configuration rollout in eu-west-1 tomorrow. Window: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expected impact: short API restarts (~<60s) for in-flight dedicated requests; hosted API should be largely unaffected but there may be brief 5xx spikes. Posting early notice for customers and ops teams :calendar: :rotating_light:

kevin: thanks — is this a full cluster rolling restart or a patch to the config service?

maria: rolling restart of the control-plane nodes after a config change (connection pool tuning + healthcheck adjustment). No driver-level kernel patches. We'll drain one node at a time.

oncall-bot: Incident scheduled: maintenance-created by maria at 2026-04-01T10:17:36Z. Pager escalations disabled during planned maint. Reminder will post 2h and 15m before the window.

emma: tagging @customer-success and @status-team. Customer comms: do we want a segmented email for Dedicated customers? Might need SLA exceptions note.

customer-success: yes please. We should highlight that Dedicated customers on reserved capacity may see less disruption, but call out the <60s restarts for some requests. Also include link to status page.

maria: agreed. Drafting status-page and email here. Please review:

status-team: paste the status page blurb here and we'll schedule publish.

maria: (status page draft)
```
Scheduled maintenance: Control-plane configuration rollout (eu-west-1)
Start: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC
Impact: Brief API restarts (~<60s) for control-plane operations; hosted inference should remain available, but transient 5xx spikes may occur. No model-serving workernodes will be restarted concurrently with customer traffic. Customers on Dedicated capacity may experience shorter or no restarts.
Notes: We will monitor closely and roll back the change if any regressions appear. Contact: support@redwood.ai and on-call via pager.
```

kevin: looks good. Suggest adding the rollback line and runbook link.

maria: adding runbook link now: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/control-plane-rolling-restart

maria: (customer email draft)
```
Subject: Planned maintenance - brief control-plane restart in eu-west-1 (2026-04-02)
Hi there — we’re performing a planned configuration rollout to improve API connection stability in eu-west-1. Maintenance window: 2026-04-02 02:00–04:00 UTC.
What to expect: Most customers will not see interruption. Some requests may return 5xx for up to ~60 seconds during node restarts. If you use Dedicated Reserved capacity, you are unlikely to be affected. No data will be changed or removed.
If you have time-sensitive production jobs scheduled during this window, please reschedule or use another region. We’ll post a status update at the start and completion of the window.
Thanks, Redwood Inference Operations
```

ben: FYI — we'll also post a short note to the developer Slack and update the docs page with the config changes.

sre-lead: please ensure the oncall has the escalation matrix in the runbook and the rollback command:
```
# rollback command snippet
kubectl apply -f /configs/control-plane/previous-config.yaml -n controlplane
systemctl restart controlplane-node
```

maria: noted. Oncall handoff plan: @kevin will own the 02:00-03:00 shift, @emma 03:00-04:00. Oncall escalation set to SRE-lead if >10m errors persist.

kevin: I'll be remote but available. Will colocate logs in the maintenance channel and call if needed.

oncall-bot: Reminder: 2h before maintenance for thread 1874023456.

(2 hours later)

oncall-bot: Reminder: 15 minutes until scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1.

kevin: starting drain of controlplane-01 now. Placing node in maintenance mode.

maria: monitoring metrics in grafana -> control-plane / node-health. Watch for request latency and 5xx rate.

kevin: controlplane-01 drained successfully. Restarting service.

kevin: short blip observed: 45s of elevated 5xxs starting 02:12:30 UTC — error rate back to baseline.

maria: logging incident note: brief spike captured in observability with no customer-reported impact so far. Publishing status update:
```
Status update: Maintenance started. We observed a brief 45s elevation in 5xxs during first node restart; no customer-impact reported. Continuing rollout.
```

status-team: published status page update.

customer-success: sending targeted email to Dedicated customers now with note that most are unaffected; copying status link.

kevin: controlplane-02 drained and restarted. No additional spikes. Rolling to controlplane-03.

emma: taking over for the next hour, will monitor.

kevin: last node restarted at 03:18 UTC. All nodes on new config.

maria: running post-checks: healthchecks OK, latency within expected delta, internal smoke tests passing.

maria: Publishing completion message and closing maintenance.

status-team: published: Maintenance completed successfully. No ongoing incidents.

maria: (final customer email draft)
```
Subject: Maintenance completed - eu-west-1 control-plane rollout
Hi — maintenance in eu-west-1 completed at 2026-04-02 03:18 UTC. We observed a short 45-second period of elevated 5xxs during the first node restart; all systems are now green. If you see any unexpected behavior, please reply to this message or open a support ticket.
Thanks, Redwood Inference Operations
```

customer-success: queued emails sent. :white_check_mark:

ben: updating changelog and internal postmortem checklist to capture lessons learned.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing thread.

oncall-bot: maintenance-closed for 1874023456 at 2026-04-02T03:20:14Z.
